title.zh: 将达沃市布杭因描笼涯布杭因描笼涯中学的名称变更为Bernardo Carpio描笼涯中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Buhangin Barangay High School in Barangay Buhangin, Davao City, to Bernardo Carpio Barangay High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Buhangin Barangay High School in Barangay Buhangin, Davao City, to Bernardo Carpio Barangay High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Buhangin Barangay tại Barangay Buhangin, Davao City thành Trường trung học phổ thông Bernardo Carpio Barangay
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Buhangin Barangay ในบารังไกย์ Buhangin, Davao City เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bernardo Carpio Barangay
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Buhangin Barangay di Barangay Buhangin, Davao City menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Bernardo Carpio Barangay
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Buhangin Barangay di Barangay Buhangin, Davao City menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bernardo Carpio Barangay

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7705_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Buhangin Barangay High School in Barangay Buhangin, Davao City, is hereby changed to Bernardo Carpio Barangay High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
